propositions: T3 and T10 criteria have never blocked in ~2,500 runs due to configuration artifact, not quality signal

Plan-review blocking is configured via default_posture='blocking' and block_threshold parameters in criteria_routing.json, with findings blocking when criterion is blocking-postured and priority exceeds threshold
T10 DetGateRule 'infra-vocabulary' uses regex matching terraform, cloudformation, kubernetes, AWS, IAC, and GitHub Actions keywords to pre-gate infra findings

T10 severity guidance restricts MAJOR-class scope to destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secret on committed path, and unauthenticated internet-reachable service to prevent lesser findings from crossing 0.90 priority threshold
Test pinning assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py and test_impact_model_versioning.py must be updated to reflect T3/T10 blocking configuration changes
